The shared account coordinator preserves canonical joint and original-source identities and needs one fresh coherent union account/ownership snapshot for combined sizing. A filtered producer view can retain full-account balances and original-source accuracy identity. Exact package export, privacy review, cross-PC delivery and registration are still separate from this source commit and require their existing authorized workflow.
